Director of Operations

Kelcie’s path to practice administration isn’t a typical one. She started her career as a Registered Veterinary Technician in emergency medicine, where she developed a calm-under-pressure approach and a sharp eye for detail that still defines her work today.
After discovering a passion for oculoplastics, she joined Dr. Henson’s team in 2016. She earned her ophthalmic certification, grew into an ophthalmology surgical technician role and eventually took on leadership of two practice locations, building the kind of hands-on clinical foundation that most administrators simply don’t have.

Today, Kelcie oversees compliance at AestheticEye, bringing the same methodical care to operations that she once brought to the surgical suite
